## MGIT ISTE Faculty Chapter Honored with Best Faculty Chapter Award of Telangana Section

News Date : 14 Feb 2025News ReportFebruary 14, 2025The Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT) has been recognized with theISTE Best Faculty Chapter of Telangana Section Awardfor its outstanding contributions and activities carried out during the year 2024. This prestigious honor was conferred during the54th ISTE National Annual Conventionheld atLamrin Tech Skills University, Ropar, Punjab.TheISTE Faculty Chapter at MGIThas played a pivotal role in fostering faculty development, research innovation, and professional excellence. Through a series of well-structured initiatives, the chapter has empowered faculty members with advanced technical knowledge, pedagogical skills, and interdisciplinary collaboration. This award is a testament to the chapter’s commitment to excellence in engineering education and faculty development.Throughout 2024, the ISTE Faculty Chapter at MGIT organized various programs aimed at enhancing:Technical Expertise:Workshops, training sessions, and expert lectures to keep faculty updated on emerging technologies.Pedagogical Skills:Faculty development programs focused on innovative teaching-learning methodologies.Research and Industry Collaboration:Encouraging faculty participation in national and international conferences, securing research grants, and fostering partnerships with industry professionals.Patent and Innovation Initiatives:Supporting faculty in patent filings and interdisciplinary research contributions.Professional Networking:Strengthening faculty ties within ISTE and the wider academic and industry network.This recognition serves as a milestone for MGIT, reflecting the dedication and relentless efforts of its faculty members, staff, students, and alumni. The institution expresses its sincere gratitude to theIndian Society for Technical Education (ISTE)for acknowledging its contributions and inspiring continuous progress in research and academic excellence.As MGIT celebrates this achievement, it remains committed to innovating teaching methodologies, enhancing institutional facilities, and fostering a learning environment that is both academically enriching and professionally rewarding. This honor not only brings pride to the institute but also strengthens its resolve to further advance the engineering education landscape.A heartfelt thank you to everyone who has supported this journey of excellence. This award marks a new beginning, and MGIT looks forward to reaching greater heights in the years to come. Here’s to continued innovation, collaboration, and success in the engineering community!

February 14, 2025
The Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT) has been recognized with theISTE Best Faculty Chapter of Telangana Section Awardfor its outstanding contributions and activities carried out during the year 2024. This prestigious honor was conferred during the54th ISTE National Annual Conventionheld atLamrin Tech Skills University, Ropar, Punjab.
TheISTE Faculty Chapter at MGIThas played a pivotal role in fostering faculty development, research innovation, and professional excellence. Through a series of well-structured initiatives, the chapter has empowered faculty members with advanced technical knowledge, pedagogical skills, and interdisciplinary collaboration. This award is a testament to the chapter’s commitment to excellence in engineering education and faculty development.
Throughout 2024, the ISTE Faculty Chapter at MGIT organized various programs aimed at enhancing:
- Technical Expertise:Workshops, training sessions, and expert lectures to keep faculty updated on emerging technologies.
- Pedagogical Skills:Faculty development programs focused on innovative teaching-learning methodologies.
- Research and Industry Collaboration:Encouraging faculty participation in national and international conferences, securing research grants, and fostering partnerships with industry professionals.
- Patent and Innovation Initiatives:Supporting faculty in patent filings and interdisciplinary research contributions.
- Professional Networking:Strengthening faculty ties within ISTE and the wider academic and industry network.
This recognition serves as a milestone for MGIT, reflecting the dedication and relentless efforts of its faculty members, staff, students, and alumni. The institution expresses its sincere gratitude to theIndian Society for Technical Education (ISTE)for acknowledging its contributions and inspiring continuous progress in research and academic excellence.
As MGIT celebrates this achievement, it remains committed to innovating teaching methodologies, enhancing institutional facilities, and fostering a learning environment that is both academically enriching and professionally rewarding. This honor not only brings pride to the institute but also strengthens its resolve to further advance the engineering education landscape.
A heartfelt thank you to everyone who has supported this journey of excellence. This award marks a new beginning, and MGIT looks forward to reaching greater heights in the years to come. Here’s to continued innovation, collaboration, and success in the engineering community!
